settings.text:
The Allergen Reality

Food allergies are not a lifestyle preference. In the UK alone, clinical data confirms that over 2.4 million adults live with diagnosed food allergies[1], while hospital admissions for severe anaphylaxis have surged by 154% over the past two decades[2].

Yet in retail aisles and commercial hospitality kitchens alike, allergen-safe alternatives are treated as compromised afterthought products: packed with chemical binders, devoid of punchy flavour, or quarantined to an isolated 'free-from' shelf.

We formulate every single recipe completely free from all 14 major regulated allergens from day one. No peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy, eggs, soy, sesame, mustard, celery, lupin, fish, crustaceans, molluscs, or sulphites. One sauce, universally safe.

Data Sources: [1] Food Standards Agency (FSA) Adult Food Allergy Prevalence Report; [2] NHS Digital / MHRA 20-Year Hospital Episode Statistics (HES).

The Ultra-Processed Trap

When mass-market condiment brands strip out gluten, eggs, or dairy, they routinely substitute them with ultra-processed fillers: modified starches, maltodextrins, xanthan gum, synthetic emulsifiers, and artificial preservatives.

Today, over 54% of total daily calorie intake in the UK comes from ultra-processed foods (UPF)[3]. The milestone 2024 British Medical Journal (BMJ) umbrella review examining nearly 10 million individuals linked high UPF consumption directly to 32 adverse health outcomes, spanning metabolic, cardiovascular, and gastrointestinal conditions.

We formulate strictly under the NOVA Category 1–3 framework. Our recipes use vine-ripened tomatoes, raw cider vinegar, honey, fermented chillies, garlic, and fresh spices. Zero industrial texturisers. Zero chemical stabilisers. Real food, period.

Data Sources: [3] British Medical Journal (BMJ 2024;384:e077310) Umbrella Review on Ultra-Processed Dietary Exposure; National Diet and Nutrition Survey (NDNS).

settings.heading: Purpose-Built. Nut-Free. Glass-Free. BRC Grade AA.
settings.subheading:
Allergen safety is only as good as the facility producing it. Our sauces are crafted in a purpose-built, dedicated nut-free and glass-free manufacturing environment operating at the highest global benchmark: BRCGS Grade AA certification.

With zero glass on site, zero airborne nut contamination, and batch-by-batch validated swab testing, we offer commercial foodservice passes and domestic tables unmatched operational peace of mind.

settings.title: THE NAKED SAUCE CO. MISSION
settings.content: “The Naked Sauce Co. was built to bring positive change to the UK. It is a growing market actively looking for niches that are genuinely UPF- and allergen-free, and sauces was a field that remained largely unexplored. That is where we come in.”
